treaty_name: Convention between Tunisia and Egypt (1989), as modified by the MLI
eif_quote: [TN MLI list] Égypte Original 08-12-1989 02-01-1991 || [EG MLI] Tunisia Original 08-Dec1989 02-Jan-1991
source_title: Convention Tunisie-Egypte 1989, French text (DGI Tunisie, jibaya.tn)

rates.quote: toutefois si la personne qui reçoit les dividendes en est le bénéficiaire effectif, l'impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 10% du montant brut des distributions.
mais si la personne qui reçoit les intérêts en est le bénéficiaire effectif, l'impôt ainsi établi ne peut excéder 10% du montant brut des intérêts.
mais si la personne qui les reçoit en est le bénéficiaire effectif, l'impôt ainsi établi, ne peut excéder 15% du montant brut des redevances.

ppt.quote: [MLI Art. 7(1), applied to this covered agreement; no DGI consolidated text available] Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: valid_from: Art. 28(a) WHT from the first day of the month following exchange of ratification (EIF on exchange, 02-01-1991) -> 1991-02-01 (derived). The French text on jibaya is a translation (Arabic original also hosted). No DGI consolidated CML version found; MLI covered by both, PPT from 2024-01-01 per map.
